topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I can’t help but reflect on the events that led to Tom’s transfer to the finance department. In our last project, the team faced some tough challenges, and I know I could have stepped up more to support him. Perhaps if I had taken a bit more of the load or offered clearer guidance earlier, things would have been different. Now, as I think about how he’s settling into his new role, I hope he finds the transition smoother than our last project. It’s a new start for him, and I really want this move to be what he needs to thrive. I’ve even messaged him a few tips from my own experience in finance. I just hope it helps.
